summary: AGI Inc, a Brazilian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026, accompanied by an Ernst & Young ISRE 2410 review report dated November 11, 2026 concluding nothing came to its attention indicating non-compliance with IAS 34. Signed by CFO Marcello Winnik Dubeux. The exhibits are unaudited interim statements and note disclosures covering financial instruments, ECL allowances, hedges, taxes, leases, contingencies and equity; no transaction, offer or corporate action is disclosed. This is routine periodic financial reporting with no special-situation angle.
